name: Derevce
source:
Somewhere far, far away there is a small kingdom on levitating islands, where Ann and Nicole live. Every day the friends water a tree, it blooms and is a delight to their eyes.

But one day the tree starts to rot and the friend suddenly disappears.

You need to find the "treasure" in the depths of the island and save your friendship!

[From [url=https://birzavr.itch.io/seedling]Itch.io[/url]]
